description: Persona 4 Golden tracks played inside Catherine. Read from the player's P4G sound banks. replaces_cc_file: Catherine file to redirect so the game itself plays the track (null = the mod plays it over the scene).

rows.title: Backside of the TV
rows._notes: Plays during the Midnight Channel intro, over Catherine's silence before Night 1. Index: find with `recon` (longest-looping tracks listed with durations).

rows.title: I'll Face Myself -Battle-
rows._notes: Shadow boss theme. Once recon names Night 1's boss BGM file in data/sound, put it in replaces_cc_file so Catherine itself plays this track instead (WAV/ADX targets supported).
